summary: Independent acceptance pass for MYRAANA production automation. Preflight pytest suite (6/6 PASS). Preview UI authenticated with the disposable preview admin: Jobs/Recipes/Shop settings navigation OK; build-info visible (commit 989b95bc4b635aefd72b815198df3bbfbf5e5655, builtAt 2026-10-11T09:15:33+00:00); cost-profiles-panel renders all 9 required numeric inputs + name + save (no persistence attempted per instructions); connector-pairing-panel with start-connector-pairing-button and download-windows-connector-link present; production-review-panel and run-production-review-button rendered (NOT clicked per instructions); all 16 task-N-summary testids present on job detail. Inspected App.js source: when agentReview response contains data.money_cost === 'UNKNOWN' (set by optimization_agent.py lines 68 and 87 when cost profile missing), UI renders '[data-testid=cost-inputs-missing] Cost inputs are unavailable; no cheapest route is claimed.' — assertion met via static source inspection without evaluation. Verified /app/test_reports/agents_e2e.json: summary {pass:35, fail:0}; results include fixture checksums (v1/v2), isolated port 8011 health, admin seed, shop settings, connector pairing (valid/invalid/expired rejection, discovery, admin approval, device credential once, read-only heartbeat), job create, upload v1, inspection+PRINT_READY, independent PRINT_READY verification (file_id 0f07d2cf-4bb9-4884-ba01-25dd8508a3c8, checksum e073a094a4c44d5d5f58b23ef977030b75911b08ffebbdf30ca57628e086fa9f), exact-file proof approval, route/handoff/readiness/authorize, disconnected shop STOP for connector reason, forged agent state 400, configured cost profile auditable estimate (total 8.72, margin 65.12%), QC never completes without operator confirmation, duplicate agent evaluation idempotent, changed artwork invalidates prior approval + stops without reapproval, QC cannot complete without real operator (HTTP 409), physical_print_enabled=false, live preview untouched by isolated DB. One check 'QC positive completion after real operator confirmation' is explicitly NOT TESTED with reason recorded. Windows hardware/spooler/DPAPI functionality is NOT TESTED (Linux/browser preview environment).

not_tested: QC positive completion after real operator confirmation (physical print disabled by design)

production_review_panel.no_cheapest_route_claim_behavior: Verified in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 352: when item.data.money_cost === 'UNKNOWN' renders [data-testid=cost-inputs-missing] 'Cost inputs are unavailable; no cheapest route is claimed.' Backend optimization_agent.py sets money_cost='UNKNOWN' at lines 68 and 87 when cost profile missing/disabled.

windows_hardware.reason: Linux/browser preview environment; no Windows spooler/DPAPI/executable verification possible.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js render for 'no cheapest route' label depends on exact string 'UNKNOWN' being present in agentReview item.data.money_cost. Any renaming in optimization_agent.py would silently drop the disclaimer. Consider centralizing the sentinel into a shared constant exported from backend contract and referenced in frontend tests.

Cost profile form has 9 numeric inputs with min/step unknown from this run; if the backend coerces strings to numbers only, missing frontend input[type=number] validation (negative or non-numeric) could allow invalid saves. No persistence attempted this run; worth adding a Zod/Yup-style schema check on save-cost-profile-button handler.

agents_e2e.json records a single intentionally NOT TESTED check for 'QC positive completion after real operator confirmation'. This is correct given the no-physical-print policy, but the field is informally embedded in the results array; consider promoting it to a top-level summary.not_tested_reasons list so downstream tooling cannot miscount 36 total vs 35 pass.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 preflight pytest; agents_e2e 35/35 scored checks pass; 1 explicitly not-tested)

test_credentials: Used preview-verification-admin@print2go.test from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; password not reproduced.
seed_data_creation: No new data created. Pre-existing cancelled TEST_* jobs left as-is.

Preflight pytest (/app/backend/tests/test_preflight_cases.py) covers the six required cases. agents_e2e.json is authoritative for isolated API behavior and should not be rerun unless the integration runner on port 8011 is explicitly needed. UI testids are stable: nav-{jobs,recipes,settings}-button, settings-page, cost-profiles-panel, cost-profile-form + cost-*-input, connector-pairing-panel, start-connector-pairing-button, download-windows-connector-link, production-review-panel, run-production-review-button, production-review-results, cost-inputs-missing, task-1..16-summary, build-info, connect-shop-button.
